title: French Climbing Bean A Cosse Violette - 2x Plug Plants - Heavy Cropper
description:
Get a fantastic head start on your vegetable patch with our 'A Cosse Violette' French Climbing Bean plug plants!
Skip the uncertainty of seeds and get straight to the growing. You will receive two healthy, established plug plants, ready to be planted into your garden, allotment, or large containers for a quick and rewarding harvest.
This stunning heritage variety is a true showstopper, producing beautiful lavender flowers followed by a heavy crop of deep purple, tender, and completely stringless pods.
Why Choose 'A Cosse Violette' Plugs?
Instant Garden: No need to sow seeds – we've done the hard work for you!
Gourmet Quality: Prized for its tender, stringless pods with a fantastic flavour.
Stunning Appearance: Adds beautiful colour to your plot with purple flowers and pods.
Highly Productive: A prolific climbing variety that ensures a long and generous harvest.
Cooking Note: To retain the beautiful deep purple colour, it is best to steam these beans, as the colour can fade when boiled.
How to Plant Your Plugs:
Planting Time: Plant out from late May onwards, once all risk of frost has passed.
Position: Find a sunny spot with rich, fertile soil.
Support: Provide canes, netting, or a trellis for the beans to climb up. They will need this support as they grow.
Care: Water well after planting. Feed with a high-potash fertiliser (like a tomato feed) once flowers appear to boost your crop.
Harvest: From June to October. Pick pods regularly to encourage the plant to produce more.
What You Will Receive:
2x healthy, well-rooted 'A Cosse Violette' plug plants, carefully packaged and ready for immediate planting.
Happy Growing!
